claim: Lee et al. 2020 train ANYmal locomotion with TRPO using a two-stage teacher-student protocol, requiring approximately 12 hours for the teacher and 4 hours for the student policy on an i7-8700K CPU + RTX 2080 desktop.
stance_target: pre-GPU-parallelism rough-terrain locomotion required ~16 hours total training on consumer hardware
scope_conditions: ANYmal quadruped, RaiSim simulator (CPU), teacher-student privileged learning, circa 2020
quoted_support: Table S1: Computation time for training. Teacher policy training: approx 12 hrs. Student policy training: approx 4 hrs. The training is conducted on a desktop machine with i7-8700K CPU and a Geforce RTX 2080 GPU.

claim: Lee et al. 2020 Table S7: teacher policy TRPO hyperparams - batch_size=80,000, total_iterations=10,000. Total teacher steps = 10,000 x 80,000 = 800M.
stance_target: derived total step counts for Lee 2020 teacher phase
scope_conditions: ANYmal quadruped, TRPO algorithm, CPU RaiSim simulator; Table S7; 2020
quoted_support: Table S7: Hyperparameters for teacher policy training. Parameter: Value. discount factor: 0.995, KL-d threshold: 0.01, max. episode length: 400, batch size: 80000, total iterations: 10000.

claim: Lee et al. 2020 Table S8: student policy (TCN-N) hyperparams - batch_size=20,000, minibatches=5, epochs=4, total_iterations=4,000. Total student steps = 4,000 x 20,000 = 80M.
stance_target: student distillation training budget in Lee 2020
scope_conditions: ANYmal student policy (TCN-N architecture), supervised learning from teacher; 2020
quoted_support: Table S8: Hyperparameters for student policy training. batch size: 20000, minibatches: 5, epochs: 4, total iteration: 4000.

claim: Lee et al. 2020 total combined training is ~880M steps (800M teacher + 80M student) over ~16 hours on a single desktop machine; this is the pre-Isaac-Gym 2020 baseline for challenging terrain ANYmal locomotion.
stance_target: total step budget for challenging terrain quadruped RL pre-GPU era
scope_conditions: Derived from Tables S7/S8; CPU-based simulator; not directly stated in paper
quoted_support: Teacher policy training: approx 12 hrs. Student policy training: approx 4 hrs. batch size 80000 total iterations 10000 [teacher]. batch size 20000 total iteration 4000 [student].

claim: Lee et al. 2020 demonstrate zero-shot generalization from sim-to-real: policy trained only on rigid terrain in simulation successfully handles mud, snow, debris, vegetation, and water in field deployment.
stance_target: sim-to-real transfer from simple simulated terrain can generalize to complex real-world conditions
scope_conditions: ANYmal deployed in multiple natural environments; DARPA SubT competition use
quoted_support: the controller successfully handles deformable terrain (mud, moss, snow), dynamic footholds (stepping on a rolling board in a cluttered indoor environment, or debris in the field), and overground impediments such as thick vegetation, rubble, and gushing water.
